title: Fixed-point neural samplers on discrete spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.01739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampling from discrete, unnormalized distributions without access to data is a challenging problem. Neural samplers offer a promising approach by training generative models from density evaluations directly. Despite recent progress, existing discrete neural samplers are prone to mode collapse, come without convergence guarantees when trained via fixed-point iterations, and are often tied to a specific reference process such as masked or uniform diffusion. In this work, we introduce Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler, a fixed-point neural sampler that addresses these limitations, enabling efficient, scalable learning, substantially reducing mode collapse in practice. Our framework builds on masked diffusion and also extends to transport between pairs of distributions. translated_title: 离散空间上的不动点神经采样器
translated_abstract: 在无法访问数据的情况下，从离散、未归一化的分布中进行采样是一个具有挑战性的问题。神经采样器提供了一种有前景的方法，它可以直接基于密度评估来训练生成模型。尽管近年来取得了一些进展，但现有的离散神经采样器容易发生模式坍缩，在通过不动点迭代训练时缺乏收敛性保证，并且通常与特定的参考过程（如掩码扩散或均匀扩散）绑定在一起。在这项工作中，我们提出了离散吉布斯迭代神经采样器，这是一种能够解决上述局限性的不动点神经采样器，可实现高效、可扩展的学习，并在实践中显著减少模式坍缩。我们的框架建立在掩码扩散的基础上，同时还可扩展到分布对之间的传输。我们证明了该方法能够有效地扩展到高维系统，支持跨不同条件的摊销采样，并能实现精确的（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出离散吉布斯迭代神经采样器，一种基于掩码扩散的不动点神经采样方法，解决了现有离散神经采样器的模式坍缩和收敛保证问题，可高效扩展至高维系统并支持跨条件的摊销采样。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler, a fixed-point neural sampler built on masked diffusion that overcomes mode collapse and convergence issues of existing discrete neural samplers, scaling effectively to high-dimensional systems and supporting amortized sampling across different conditions.
